method: Per-file classification by ACTUAL BEHAVIOR: static signal scan (imports, client construction, ports, env reads, jest.mock/vi.mock) cross-checked against EXECUTION evidence — tests/TEST_TIERS.json (env-redirect + socket-guard runs) plus a fresh tier-1 `npx jest --json` run (355 suites: 353 pass, 2 fail) executed during this audit.

tierDefinitions.1: hermetic unit — no network, no real DB, no real model calls; mocks all externals
tierDefinitions.2: local integration — touches local services (local postgres, local fs, spawned local processes) but no external network
tierDefinitions.3: local service/system — requires running local services (the app itself, PM2, docker)
tierDefinitions.4: qualification — tests/qualification/** population and similar end-to-end gates
tierDefinitions.5: external/live — requires external systems (real Stripe, real cloud APIs, deployed services)
